The packet does not detail causes or consequences. The source ranks the scenario frequency B, severity I, Low risk, and lists no existing safeguard (CASE-03), so no detection is currently credited for this deviation. The proposed action is the source's own recommendation: confirm whether the PIT-101 low-pressure alarm is active in the control room and activate it if needed. The packet does not establish that new hardware is required. Reliability: 95 of 100 demands delivered means 95% success, and 5 of 100 not delivered means 5% unavailability.
